MUT_SURVIVOR_TEXT: The surviving mutation is "Krawczyk drops the parameter term of J". Removing the term $\sum_l(YJ_{q_l})[-h_P,h_P]$ from $\mathcal M$ in Lemma 17 makes the test unsound in principle, but the omitted quantity is of second order, $|YJ_q|\,h_P\,\rho$, and it is dominated in practice by the overestimation of the other second-order terms ($|YJ_w|\rho^2$ from the Jacobian over $W$ and $|YF_{qq}|h_P^2$ from the value term), so it is not exposed by any test of the suite — neither by the stress test T10 with coarse parameter boxes nor by the white-box sampling test T11 — and no test of this kind can be expected to expose it. Its presence in the kernel rests on the proof of Lemma 17 and on inspection of the code.
